QuestInfo.name: Composition Fee
QuestInfo.0: You found and returned Maestro Rho's MP3 player. That ought to be enough to get a new song, right? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for a new song Blake can perform during his debut concert.
QuestInfo.1: A composition fee?! I guess a fancy composer like you would expect that kind of money. Would you do me a favor and get some fancy amplifier cables for #bMaestro Rho#k while I work on getting those mesos?
QuestInfo.2: You have paid the fee, but he still seems reluctant to give you the song. What's up with that? Talk to #bMaestro Rho#k again.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 8,450\nCan proceed to the Say No to Plagiarism quest\n

0.0: Hey, you're #h0#, the one who found my MP3! So what did you want to tell me?\r\n#L0##bBlake from the subway station of Kerning Square is trying to... (You explain the situation.) So now he needs a new song for his debut concert. Would you compose one for him?#l\n#k
0.1: Compose... Ah, ha ha! I don't know if you know this, but I'm kind of a big deal. I'm a famous and respected composer. The fee for my music is hefty. You came prepared to pay, didn't you?

yes.0: Fancy amplifier cables should be enough to negate my composition fees! Plus, I really need a set to rock out with. Bring me #b50 Fancy Amplifier Cables#k from the #r7th - 8th Floors of Kerning Square#k and we'll call it even.

no.0: But I can't just give you a song for free. Think about what it would do to my reputation!

1.0: You have what I want? Now we're talking.

yes.0: One, two, three... You brought all the cables I wanted. Okay, here it is. As promised, here are my Composition Notes with a new hit song. (He seems reluctant to let go of his Composition Notes.)

item.0: Did you forget that a song from me is worth at least #b50 Fancy Amplifier Cables#k? Please bring them from the 7th-8th floor of Kerning Square.
